models_evaluated: auto-segmentation model for colon identification (deployed on NVIDIA Jetson)

links.outcome: ICGFA interpretation model IOU on unseen videos from other surgeons, institutions and imaging systems
links.effect: Test IOU 0.62 on held-out same-institution data fell to 0.45 on 15 additional unseen videos, with no prediction for one poor-perfusion case.
links.quote: Further ICGFA model testing on 15 additional unseen videos returned IOU = 0.45 with, importantly, no prediction when classifying one case of poor perfusion.

screen.reason: The study describes the design, technical validation, and real-time live in-theatre deployment (in 15 surgeries) of an intraoperative computer vision device (AUGUR-AI) interpreting fluorescence angiography, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
